arguments.command:
set -e
git checkout -b release-0.35.1
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='CHANGELOG.md'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("## [Unreleased]\n","## [Unreleased]\n\n## [0.35.1] - 2026-11-11\n\n### Changed\n\n- Pit depends on `oxfmt` 0.77.0, which formats programs shown in expanded `typescript` rows. Development uses `oxlint` 1.92.0 and `vitest` 5.1.0.\n",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='README.md'; s=open(p).read(); s=s.replace("pit@v0.35.0","pit@v0.35.1"); open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm version 0.35.1 --no-git-tag-version >/dev/null
git diff --stat
